components.name: Numeric Field
components.css: .ds-numeric-field{display:grid;gap:7px;color:#606777;font:650 12px/1.35 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-numeric-field input{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:46px;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #BFC1C8;border-radius:0;background:#FFFDF8;color:#202838;text-align:center;font:600 16px/1.35 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-numeric-field input:hover{border-color:#606777}.ds-numeric-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #C88725;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: KPI Cell
components.css: .ds-kpi-cell{display:flex;min-height:80px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:7px 16px;border-right:1px solid #BFC1C8;border-bottom:1px solid #BFC1C8;border-radius:0;background:#F6F3EC;color:#202838;text-align:center}.ds-kpi-cell strong{color:#283B86;font:650 32px/1 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-kpi-cell span{max-width:12ch;font:400 13px/1.35 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-kpi-cell:hover{background:#FFFDF8}.ds-kpi-cell:focus-within{outline:3px solid #C88725;outline-offset:-3px}

components.name: Evidence Row
components.css: .ds-evidence-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,1fr) minmax(110px,1fr) auto;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #BFC1C8;border-radius:0;background:#FFFDF8;color:#202838;font:400 14px/1.5 system-ui,"Noto Sans TC","Microsoft JhengHei",sans-serif}.ds-evidence-row:hover{background:#F0F1F6}.ds-evidence-row:focus-within{outline:3px solid #C88725;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: Credit XAI Audit presents verified Machine Learning and Trustworthy AI evidence as a compact editorial research console. A warm reading field, deep-indigo structure, restrained amber state accents, large Traditional Chinese thesis copy, and dense evidence rows make the interface feel like a serious technical publication rather than a generic risk dashboard. The product remains an educational replay of a historical 2005 dataset, never a lending system or financial decision tool.
narrative.keyCharacteristics: Depth is flat. Create hierarchy with one-pixel rules, tonal fields, aligned columns, type scale, and occasional three-pixel structural boundaries. Do not use shadows, floating panels, blur, glass effects, or decorative gradients.
narrative.rules: The desktop container is at most 1440px wide. The first viewport follows a 12-column editorial composition: thesis and scope boundary, four equal KPI cells, then an 8/4 input-to-result workspace. At the 820px compact breakpoint, columns stack, KPIs become a 2-by-2 grid, and feature inputs reduce without page-level horizontal scrolling. Center only short, equal-weight content such as status cells, KPI pairs, tab labels, compact controls, short numeric values, and the primary action. Keep thesis copy, explanatory prose, form groups, model metadata, attributions, and evidence rows left-aligned.
narrative.dos: Do keep Traditional Chinese primary, use original technical terms, preserve visible focus, maintain stable loading and error geometry, and trace every public claim to committed evidence. Do center only short, equal-weight content. Do preserve the historical educational-audit, privacy, CPU-only, and non-decision boundaries.
narrative.donts: Don't use rounded dashboard cards, pills, fabricated numbers, decision language, shadows, decorative animation, or network-loaded visual assets. Don't imply causal proof, current-market fairness, lending eligibility, approval, rejection, or financial advice. Don't let runtime requests, responses, bundles, or caches write into the public repository.
